title: Condorcet winner and nonunanimity
statement: Let $w$ assign one of the two signs $-1$ or $1$ to each of the three pairwise contests among three alternatives. Then there exists a Condorcet winner, meaning one of the alternatives satisfies its corresponding two winning-sign conditions, if and only if the three contest signs are not all equal.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ is a function from the three pairwise contests to the two signs
